parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL ID CHEMBL1075189 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound CHEMBL ID.
